newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor futures market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor futures market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Bombay Oilseeds and Oils Exchange was closed on Tuesday for a local holiday. Trading resumes on Wednesday.
On Monday, castorseed June delivery dropped to 1,178/1,179 per quintal from 1,186/1,187 rupees on fresh speculative selling, traders said.
Groundnut oil rose 3.0 rupees to 357/358 rupees per 10 kg in the absence of fresh arrivals and a shortage of ready stock.

Imported palm oil also gained 7.0 rupees to 292/293 rupees per 10 kg as movement of palm oil from Bombay port to the market came to a halt because of a strike by transporters. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 540/545 rupees per 15 kg.
